why.text: N1b · the analytics kit on Analytics (approved kit: Neel mockup § Analytics kit). Same question as A·1: where this period's orders came from and what each kept after returns. New here: the period picker (Today · 7 · 30 days · This month · Custom; 90 days becomes Custom), figures with their change in words and colour by meaning, a daily trend with offer notes, prepaid/COD by week, when orders come, came back by state, shoppers who come back. Visits, sources and pincodes stay, redrawn with the kit. ₹ kept only for owners and admins (staff see the same page without it).
